observations: 2015 Acta Diabetologica report titled “Exome sequencing identifies novel ApoB loss-of-function mutations causing hypobetalipoproteinemia in type 1 diabetes.”

entities.name: APOB
observations: The study reported two heterozygous APOB premature-stop loss-of-function mutations in DCCT participants with type 1 diabetes and hypobetalipoproteinemia.

entities.name: APOB LoF in T1D
observations: Exome sequencing of two DCCT participants with type 1 diabetes and hypobetalipoproteinemia found heterozygous APOB premature stops at amino acids 1333 and 3680; LDL-C was 36 and 28 mg/dL, and each variant was inherited from a parent. Findings support a plausible explanation in these cases; no functional validation was reported in the abstract.
